sources.snippet: The Model was trained on an A100 for apprx. 2 hrs using unsloth. This model is a 2 stage fine tune on a closed source data mix. This was trained for complex texting conversations, and SpeakSciences-Preview (Not Available to the Public) was trained on Qwen3.6-27b and used in a real Discord Server context and produced indistinguishable results.
